name: native-copilot.nvim
description: Native Neovim UI and durable multi-agent host for GitHub Copilot

scripts.test:e2e:observe: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile allow-all -Observe
scripts.test:e2e:allow-all: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile allow-all
scripts.test:e2e:allow-all-mcp: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile allow-all-mcp
scripts.test:e2e:manual-permissions: npm run build && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File scripts/run-visible-e2e.ps1 -Profile manual-permissions
